name: Quantastica
description: Quantastica provides quantum programming tools and simulators for developers and researchers. The company develops open-source and commercial quantum software development tools, including quantum circuit simulators and programming frameworks. Quantastica's solutions aim to make quantum computing more accessible to software developers through intuitive programming interfaces and educational resources.

products.name: Quantum Programming Studio
products.description: Web-based IDE for designing, simulating, and debugging quantum circuits with visual circuit editor and multiple backend support

products.name: Quantum Circuit Simulators
products.description: Open-source and commercial quantum circuit simulation tools for developers and researchers

highlights: Provides accessible quantum programming tools aimed at lowering the barrier to entry for developers
